question: Aparna Satheesan was honoured with the prestigious Bharata Shastra Nritya Praveena National Award for her outstanding performance in which dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aparna Satheesan** is a **Kuchipudi and Bharatanatyam dancer, choreographer and teacher.**
 
• She is well known globally for her ability to use creativity in presenting innovative ideas through multiple **classical dance forms of India.**
 
• She was awarded the Abhinandan Saroja award for her contribution to classical dance in **November 2021.**
 
• The selection panel of judges included very famous dancers like **Dr Swati Daithankar, Sri. Narendra Kumar, Smt. Sukanya Mahadevan and Smt. Aparna Ramesh.**
 
• **Aparna Satheesan** win the **Prestigious National Nritya Shiromani Award 2022 in Kuchipudi.**
